title: Vector of indices stored in memory
statement: For an index map $I$ from $t$ positions to the natural numbers below $n$, a memory function $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, and a starting address $a$, say that $I$ is stored at $a$ when the cell at $a+k$ contains the integer cast of the value of $I(k)$ for every position $k<t$.
